question: What do the landed ML research results say by their own pre-registered rules, and what follows?
population: 14 units found by grep of family ids/model names in research/queue and research/results: 9da8-01 (Chronos-2 bake-off), TabICL/TabPFN units 1414-06, eda2-02, ff8f-02, 38be-01, 4a3b-01 (retired, producer timed out), 65cc-06/-07/-08, GRU units ff8f-04, c0d1, c0d2, c0d3, plus 4591-02 (direction, tabular learners not involved; read for completeness). All 14 have >=1 result row; 9da8-02 (meta-label tabular bake-off) is in blocked/ with NO result. TimesFM-2.5, TiRex-2, Kronos, TTM: no unit run (no loader).

results_read.machine_verdict: fail (2 consecutive measured rows 39844193455, 40074055932; 1 producer_failed row 39923386978)
results_read.lane_verdict: underpowered for the FAIL; PASS rejected
results_read.reasoning: power_state accruing and no accrual_override_reason. From the MEASURED fold sd (BTC cv chronos2-vs-incumbent CI half-width 0.009 over 5 folds, SD ~0.0073) the +0.005 FAIL floor needs ~17 folds, 5 were run, so the FAIL cannot be certified. The PASS is rejected: BTC delta vs incumbent -0.0030 (CI -0.0148..+0.0087) and -0.0057 (CI -0.0146..+0.0033); upper bound below the +0.010 bar in both runs. Same-data re-run moved single deltas by up to 0.014 (BTC holdout vs incumbent -0.0187 -> -0.0041; n 78,873 -> 78,735), so run-to-run instrument noise is comparable to the effect. Headlines: HAR-RV and VAR controls did NOT match the incumbent on BTC cv (-0.0144/-0.0107 vs incumbent, run 1/2); the neural forecaster adds nothing detectable here and nothing is lost by the controls being weaker. Holdout deltas are single-fold, no interval.

MES 1d tabpfn-vs-lgbm +0.0210 (CI +0.0017..+0.0403, sign-consistent) clears +0.010; BTC 15m last-3000 delta is exactly 0.0000 because all three arms (lgbm, prior, tabpfn) return the identical fold scores (1.0 / 0.4958 ...): the BTC group is degenerate (collapse to the class prior), so the both-datasets PASS clause cannot hold. tabpfn arm_status ok here (the licence error seen on 2026-10-14/15 in 1414-06 did not recur).
tabicl: MES +0.0141 (CI -0.0007..+0.0289), BTC -0.0033; tabpfn arm error (licence/token) = route fault. Earlier rows producer_failed (exit 75) and two re-grades.
tabicl vs lightgbm cv macro_f1 BTC +0.0001, ETH -0.0005, SOL -0.0966; no clause holds, every CI spans 0. tabpfn control error = CPU >5,000-sample refusal (instrument, fixed same day).

tabicl_ens vs lightgbm BTC -0.0132, ETH -0.0123, SOL +0.0079; only SOL > 0 holds. Its only sign-consistent finding is tabicl_ens beats the PRIOR on SOL (+0.0530, CI +0.0059..+0.1001) -- the same size as lightgbm-vs-prior there (+0.0451), i.e. a feature effect, not a TabICL effect.
producer timed out at 300 min; status retired; redesigned as 38be-01.

tabicl and tabpfn not importable on the backend: arms unavailable, so nothing candidate-side was measured; the rows only measured the lgbm/logit/prior controls (65cc-08: lgbm beats prior on macro_f1 by 0.135 BTC / 0.227 ETH, sign-consistent).
machine verdict fail, power_state accruing, no override => lane reads it as underpowered; recorded for completeness, not part of the asked families.
gru vs lightgbm BTC +0.0018 / ETH +0.0163 / SOL +0.0060, every CI spans 0; confounded (GRU saw 10 features, lightgbm 6).

results_read.unit: RQ-20261022-c0d1/c0d2/c0d3 (GRU variants: fair control, window sweep, deep/slow)
results_read.reasoning: vs the FAIR wide lightgbm: c0d1 BTC +0.0088 / ETH +0.0035 / SOL +0.0007; c0d2 w16/w64/w96 BTC +0.015/+0.007/+0.023, ETH +0.012/+0.006/+0.010, SOL -0.005/+0.004/+0.006; c0d3 gru_deep +0.0207/+0.0128/+0.0095 (8 folds). 17 of 18 symbol-configs point positive but none has a CI excluding 0 and none clears +0.010 on all three symbols (c0d3 SOL 0.0095). The measured fold sd of the delta is ~0.03 (c0d3 BTC CI half-width 0.0255 over 8 folds), so detecting +0.010 needs ~70 folds: the GRU question is underpowered by design, not answered. Not a FAIL, not a PASS.
